name: browser_vision
description: Opens a browser to a URL, optionally executes UI actions (click, type), and uses Vision LLM (or DOM fallback) to analyze the screenshot.

actions_json.description: JSON string of UI actions to execute. Example: '[{"action":"wait_for","selector":"#app"}, {"action":"click","selector":"#btn"}, {"action":"type","selector":"#search","text":"hello"}, {"action":"wait","time":2}]'

vision_prompt.description: The prompt to ask the Vision LLM about the captured screenshot. E.g. 'Is the login button red?'
